notes.title: FUNKYHEART Trailer and Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Yeahhh, it's been a while, but after a good amount of work I am very excited to announce the FUNKYHEART release date, including a new trailer and a DEMO!![/p][p][/p][p]A demo huh..? To be honest not even I was expecting that, but here we are![/p][p][/p][p]Get to play two of the early levels in the game, just so you can experience a bit of FUNKYHEART before the actual release![/p][p][/p][p]There are so many new details here! New cover art, new music, new characters, new everything! Plus, so many more surprises when the game officially releases! I'm so excited to show everything else in the game, but let's just wait a little bit more...[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for keeping an eye on this game, I will always appreciate it - and feel free to let me know your thoughts, it definitely helps![/p][p][/p][p]juicce[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1GQCd_nfvlw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p]
